children: Peru’s Central Reserve Bank unexpectedly kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 4.25% in October 2026, extending its pause for a 13th consecutive meeting, defying market expectations of a 25 bps hike.

Annual inflation accelerated to a three-month high of 4.55% in September from 4.44% in August. This marked the seventh consecutive month above the central bank’s 1%-3% target range, as higher global fuel and electricity prices continued to impact transportation.

title: Peru Unexpectedly Holds Rate at 4.25%
